goal: Friendly destination-based navigation and honest duration descriptions while preserving current media classification
excluded: Automatic duration indexing or recursive scans

approval.evidence: 2026-11-08 user requested detailed duration labels and navigation understandable without computer knowledge. After learning that current mid videos are about 11 minutes and four shorts exceed 5 minutes slightly, user chose: 기존 분류를 유지하고 각 분류에 실제 길이 설명 표시. This codifies those direct instructions without claiming approval of a separately presented document.

requirements.statement: Keep classifications and show actual approximate length descriptions
requirements.acceptance: Display 단편 (약1~5분) and 중편 (약11분) on selection cards/headings; original paths and all media identities remain unchanged. Descriptions reflect current imported media rather than strict category thresholds.

requirements.statement: Use clear destination-based navigation without breadcrumbs or computer-specific navigation terms
requirements.acceptance: At a character screen show 처음으로; at a nested screen show 처음으로 plus a named return destination. Display current character context and current selection; remove breadcrumb chain and visible/ARIA 상위 폴더 wording. Buttons work via direct links, browser back and small screens.

requirements.statement: Publish and preserve existing service behavior
requirements.acceptance: JAR/Docker checks and existing suites pass; covers, cache and native playback remain connected; deployed resources match merged source with original mounts and limits.
